experience.org: Stellant Systems, Inc. (RF and microwave amplifier hardware)
bullets: Cut predicted junction temperature of a power-supply module 57.6 °C (122.5 to 64.9 °C) in ANSYS Mechanical steady-state thermal FEA by adding a gap pad; traded aluminum vs. copper heat spreaders and recommended aluminum for mass and cost.

Root-caused a non-physical 600 °C hot spot to a missing thermal interface material (TIM) layer; revised contact conductance from vendor data and re-meshed thin PCB layers, bringing the prediction within 2–3 °C of test thermocouple readings.

Designed a multi-diameter O-ring cutting fixture in Autodesk Inventor over four FDM iterations using Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T, ASME Y14.5) and tolerance stack-up, documented in my first Engineering Change Notice (ECN) and now in shop-floor use; took a second mounting-plate fixture to manufacturing in 3 weeks.

Redesigning a silicone gasket for an altitude-chamber vacuum leak test of a hermetic unit (groove-matched profile, GD&T drawings, 3D-printed mold, degassed injection-molded liquid silicone; leak test pending); iterated a 3D-printed silicone syringe-pouring fixture through three versions and updated compressor re-machining drawings.

Automated CAD/FEA data: built an Inventor-to-Excel macro for Bill of Materials (BOM) checks and cost roll-ups, wrote an IronPython material-mapping script for a 327-body ANSYS model, and converted a legacy AutoCAD drawing set to Inventor in 1 day vs. a 3-day estimate (8 clamp sizes).

Create and audit BOMs under configuration control, author Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) routed through formal engineering review, and review thermal-interface drawings for plating compatibility and galvanic-corrosion risk.

leadership.org: American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA), Hofstra Student Branch
bullets: Reversed a provisional decharter by meeting AIAA's membership, faculty-advisor, and annual-report requirements; AIAA confirmed the branch officially chartered (Nov. 2026).
Grew the branch from a 16-student interest list to 38 students in under three months.
Raised $5,000 from two industry sponsors (Academy of Aviation, East/West Industries) to send 5 members to AIAA SciTech 2027.

Student contact for Hofstra's AIAA Design/Build/Fly 2026–27 entry (submitted team roster and proposal); co-hosted an AIAA Long Island Section campus lecture and drafted two AIAA Classroom Grant proposals submitted by a Long Island Earth and Space Science teacher.

leadership.org: Society of Hispanic Professional Engineers (SHPE), Hofstra Chapter
bullets: Restarted a chapter dormant for 18+ years: recruited the executive board, wrote the constitution, filed for university recognition, organized the first Meet the Board event (Oct. 7, 2026), and grew to 47 members.
Represented Hofstra as its only attendee at SHPE National Convention 2026; co-hosted a four-club engineering mixer with ASME, CSA, and SWE and set up a resume workshop.
Chapter Winner ($300), SHPE National's SHPE's Got Talent (Oct. 2026).

leadership.org: American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME), Hofstra Section
bullets: Sole Hofstra delegate to ASME Student Leadership Weekend (Philadelphia, Oct. 2026); presented ideas for rebuilding the section.
Secured donated outreach materials from Mouser Electronics and PCB samples from LPKF.
Recruited an interim faculty advisor, ran steam-turbine and catapult builds, and co-planned the Night Shift Engineering Mixer with SHPE, SWE, and CSA within a $160 SGA catering budget.
Co-directed the CSTEP student community board at Hofstra University (CSTEP Scholar).

honors: Nominee, Aviation Week Network 20 Twenties, Class of 2027 (university nomination, Oct. 2026)
